description.value: Carter Park is a nature reserve on Bowen Island managed by Bowen Island Municipality. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay and draws cyclists looking to explore its forested roads and natural areas. The park's exact facilities and trail character are not documented in available sources.
